title: Needs Improvement
text:
Needs Improvement. First let me say that this is a very well constructed machine. I have no problem with the grinder mechanism or container from a quality standpoint. I do think there are several things that would make it easier to use.

First off it needs a wider base. When you are grinding it is moving all over the counter because the top is heavier than the bottom.

Something to hold on to around the diameter would be helpful. I have decreasing hand strength and trying to hold the slick outer surface of this while grinding was a grind. LOL

It took me at least 7 minutes to grind enough for one cup of coffee in my Keurig. If you need to grind a lot, this isn't your machine.

Some guidance on the number you should use based on the coffee maker you have would be useful as well.

It would be nice if the handle flipped over for storage because as it is now it does take some space to store.
